claim: The IEA projects renewables as the fastest-growing power source for data centres, meeting nearly half of additional demand through 2030 while power-sector emissions for data-centre electricity peak around 2030 and then decline modestly.
shortLabel: Renewables meet about half of added demand
displayValue: Nearly half of added demand through 2030
comparisonContext: This system-scale projection keeps demand growth and cleaner supply growth in the same frame.
scopeNote: Projected additional supply contribution in the IEA Base Case, not a claim that total data-centre power becomes mostly renewable by 2030.
